newsitem.title: GREECE: DEPA SIGNS 1.8BLN DRS NETWORK DEAL WITH ATHENS GAS.
newsitem.headline: DEPA SIGNS 1.8BLN DRS NETWORK DEAL WITH ATHENS GAS.

text.p: Athens Gas and the Public Gas Corporation of Greece (DEPA) signed a contract for developing part of the natural gas distribution network, budgeted at 1.8 billion drachmas, Athens Gas said in a statement on Friday.
Athens Gas SA comprises 17 municipalities in Attica covering 50 percent of all its residents, it added.
It also decided to double its own equity, which will now total 200 million drachmas. --Margarita Sotiropoulou, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
